question_text: A 29-year-old woman with hypothyroidism comes to her primary care physician for advice on a health insurance plan. She works as a baker and owns a small bakery. The patient explains that she would like to have affordable monthly premiums. She would be willing to make additional payments to be able to see providers outside her network and to get specialist care if referred by her primary care physician. Which of the following health insurance plans would be most appropriate?
